entities.summary: Mirza Mehdi Khan Astarabadi, also known by his title of Monshi-ol-Mamalek, was the chief secretary, historian, biographer, advisor, strategist, friend and confidant of Nader Shah. He wrote and accepted the different decisions and files related to the Empire.
